name: 状態の構成を円環で示す案件グラフのひな型
prompt:
Recreate the standalone Asana chart tile in the primary original crop. Match its 300:207 aspect ratio (about 1.45:1), full rounded white card, faint gray border, inner padding and compact typography. The original crop controls chart geometry, segment angles and colors; use the Japanese mock only for the title wording.

At the top left, place the compact title 「状態ごとの案件」 in a restrained dark sans-serif weight. In the lower half, place a smooth doughnut chart on the left and a three-row legend on the right.

Match the source doughnut: three uninterrupted segments, starting at 12 o’clock and proceeding clockwise—small rose-pink segment across the upper right, yellow segment down the right side, and the larger vivid mint-green segment wrapping the left and bottom. Keep the same relative segment proportions, ring thickness and white circular hole. Center one short, pale-gray rounded capsule inside the hole, with no text.

Align exactly three legend rows beside the doughnut, vertically centered: a small rounded square in pink, yellow, and green order, each followed by a short light-gray rounded placeholder stroke matching the source lengths. The source legend wording is unreadable; do not invent labels, values, percentages or extra marks.

Keep the title and chart sizes, card margins, alignment and light neutral styling close to the original. Do not add axes, numbers, grid lines, extra colors, shadows, or page context.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 visually compared side-by-side with the original 2x crop. Dimensions 1510x1042 (1.4491:1) against source 300x207 (1.4493:1); SHA-256 3302d0a02dd3030583297926499c19ec357282d6c80069a54e5f7a88e8f8d297. The doughnut size/placement, three segment colors and proportions, center capsule, and three placeholder legend rows closely match. Japanese title is legible and no data values were invented. Status: reviewed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
